item.revised_prompt: The X-shaped layout of four red endpoint dots connected by intersecting blue diagonal lines in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The top cover features four distinct panel seams dividing the housing into separate access sections around the central electronics bay. Each arm plugs into a distinct recessed socket along the shell perimeter, marked by a crisp transverse joint seam. Projecting slightly beyond the front clipped-edge nose outline is a forward-facing camera gimbal assembly; because of the strict overhead viewpoint, only its upper housing and side profile are visible while its horizontally oriented optical lens face remains hidden.
